releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: 16 commits across 3 repos; opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogeisetsu pushed 16 commits across three repositories. In sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu (8 commits, 1 automated by github-actions[bot]), the user reworked commit statistics to use commit date with separate bot tracking, added status badges with UTC+8 timestamps, fixed cache busting for report links, kept bot-only repos visible, added a GitHub homepage button, changed the 30-day card to refresh every 2 hours, and added AI failure fallback to retain the last narrative. In sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch (6 commits), the user cleaned up local worktree ignore blocks, added live Q2 comparison results across three skills, documented a deep research evaluation standard, landed landing-page feedback, and fixed stray spaces around em dashes. In sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker (2 commits), the user documented vision verification and Windows refresh paths, added a role-overview column, and introduced agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts. The repository also published release v1.3.0, which bundles v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 work including new agent discovery and snapshot summary CLI tools, improved chain safety checks, and a role overview column in recommendations. No pull requests, issues, or reviews were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: Two versions of work (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0) are rolled up. Adds scripts/discover-agents.mjs for listing custom agents and flagging risky fallback chains, and scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs for compact model snapshot digests. The recommendation table now includes a role overview column.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 16 次提交；opencode-go-model-picker 发布 v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共提交 16 次。在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu（8 次提交，其中 1 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交），用户将提交统计改为按 commit date 计算并区分机器人与本人，新增状态徽章与 UTC+8 时间显示，修复报告链接缓存击穿问题，保留纯机器人仓库的显示，添加 GitHub 主页按钮，将 30 天卡片改为每 2 小时刷新，并为 AI 失败场景增加保留上次叙述的兜底逻辑。在 sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch（6 次提交），用户清理了本地 worktree 的 ignore 配置，补充了三项技能的 Q2 实时对比结果，撰写了深度研究评估标准文档，落地了落地页反馈修改，并修复了破折号前后的多余空格。在 sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker（2 次提交），用户记录了视觉验证与 Windows 刷新路径文档，新增角色概览列，并引入 agent-discovery 与 snapshot-summary 脚本。该仓库同日发布了 v1.3.0，合并了 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0 的工作，包含新的 agent 发现与快照摘要 CLI 工具、改进的链安全检查，以及推荐表中的角色概览列。当日无 Pull Request、Issue 或 Review 记录。

releaseNotes.summary: 合并了 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0 两个版本的工作。新增 scripts/discover-agents.mjs 用于列出自定义 agent 并标记风险回退链，以及 scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs 用于生成精简的模型快照摘要。推荐表现在包含角色概览列。
